column1: # Stage S13 W1, first of four: the API application leaves `apps/` and becomes the crate api_server,
# the top crate of the API family at `crates/api/api_server`; its documentation mirror moves with
# it under `documentation/crates/api/api_server`. Its two binaries take self-describing names
# (`api-server`, `import-item-registry`), so their entry files take those names too.
# The crate path `api::` becomes `api_server::` in the moved crate and in the API crates' prose
# that names its router and composition root. The rows name the crate's two modules
# (`api::router::`, `api::composition::`), never the bare `api::`: a one-segment prefix also
# matches the bare word `api` in comments and string literals, route paths such as `/api/v1`
# among them. `rkyv::api::` and other paths that only end in `api` are not leading prefixes and
# stay. Package and binary names in commands (`-p api`, `--bin api`) have no `text` row: `api` is
# a common word, and those commands are edited by hand.
